preferences.label: Appearance & companion
preferences.description: Choose the interface language and theme, and manage desktop companion feedback.

language.heading: Interface language
language.description: Choose the language R-Code uses. Changes take effect immediately.
language.label: Language

notifications.heading: System notifications
notifications.description: While R-Code is in the background, system banners alert you to approvals, failed runs, and results ready for review. In the foreground, R-Code uses in-app messages first.

granted.label: System notifications allowed
granted.description: R-Code can show system banners while it is in the background.

denied.label: System notifications denied
denied.description: Alerts will still appear in the app. If no permission prompt appears, allow R-Code in the operating system's notification settings.

prompt.label: Notification permission not requested
prompt.description: R-Code only shows the system permission prompt after you request it here.

unavailable.label: System notifications unavailable
unavailable.description: This platform or runtime cannot send system notifications. Alerts will fall back to in-app messages.

notifications.permissionError: Could not read system notification permission: {{detail}}

updater.heading: Application updates
updater.description: Check for signed R-Code releases. Downloading, installing, and restarting always require an explicit action from you.
updater.noReleaseNotes: No release notes were provided for this version.
updater.restartDeferred: The update is installed. You can continue working and restart R-Code when convenient.
updater.safetyNotice: Automatic checks request version information at most once every 6 hours and never download or install. A failed update does not replace the working version.

notifications.reviewPartialBody: Changes were preserved, but the summary failed. Review the workspace before continuing.
notifications.reviewReadyBody: The task finished and its changes are ready for your review.
notifications.runFailedBody: The run could not finish. Open the task to review the error and retry.
notifications.interruptedBody: The run was interrupted. Open the conversation to review its last step.

native.reviewBody: The latest changes are ready for your review.
native.failureBody: The run could not finish. Open the task to review the error and retry.
native.automationBody: Open the run to review the result.

errors.unknown: R-Code couldn't complete that action. Try again or copy the technical details for support.

workspace.binding_invalid: This task's project folder is no longer available. Reattach it before continuing.
workspace.home_unavailable: R-Code cannot access your home folder for this conversation.

worktree.feature_disabled: Worktree execution is disabled in Settings.
worktree.binding_invalid: This task's worktree is no longer valid. Re-enable it before continuing.
worktree.dirty: This worktree contains changes and cannot be removed automatically.
worktree.required: This action requires an isolated worktree.

browser.runtime_hash_mismatch: The browser runtime failed its integrity check. Repair it before continuing.
browser.interaction_permission_required: Permission is required to interact with {{origin}}.

automation.overlap_skipped: This run was skipped because the automation is already running.
automation.capability_denied: This automation is not allowed to use {{capability}}.

updater.signature_invalid: The update signature is invalid. Your current installation was not changed.
updater.check_failed: R-Code could not check for updates. Check your network connection and try again.
updater.download_failed: R-Code could not download version {{version}}. Your current installation was not changed.
updater.install_failed: R-Code could not install version {{version}}. The current version remains usable.
updater.restart_failed: The update was installed, but R-Code could not restart automatically. Restart the application manually.
updater.persistence_failed: R-Code could not save the update-check state, so this check was stopped.
updater.operation_in_progress: Another update action is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
updater.invalid_state: This action is not available in the current update state.

notifications.service_unavailable: System notifications are temporarily unavailable. Alerts will still appear in the app.
notifications.permission_request_failed: R-Code could not request system notification permission. Check the operating system's notification settings and try again.
